description: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8R8 — dual-core Xtensa LX7 MCU module (240 MHz) with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n, Bluetooth 5 LE, 8 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, and on-board PCB antenna. The workhorse Wi-Fi MCU for maker PCBs; native USB on GPIO19/20 means no USB-serial chip required.
name: esp32-s3-wroom-1
watch_out_for: Strapping pins (IO0, IO3, IO45, IO46) set boot mode; keep them from being held by external loads at reset. The PCB antenna needs the keep-out region from the datasheet (no copper, no ground plane within the marked zone) or Wi-Fi range tanks. Single 3.3 V supply, ~500 mA peak.
